title: Grave Offerings
description: A row of weathered headstones stands along a cobbled path, each grave adorned with fresh offerings that someone — or something — placed here recently. Bundles of dark flowers, small leather pouches of coin, and woven grass charms sit atop the mossy stone. The air smells of turned earth and wilted petals.

choices.label: Take the coins
choices.description: The dead have no use for gold, but the living do.

choices.label: Gather the deadman's grass
choices.description: The dark grass woven into the charms grows only on graves — herbalists covet it.

choices.label: Collect the grave dust
choices.description: Fine dust from freshly tended graves holds potent alchemical properties.

choices.label: Respect the dead
choices.description: Grave robbing carries its own kind of curse.
